description: This Java source file defines the ProductSearchEvents class, which handles various HTTP events related to product searching within the OFBiz framework. It includes methods for modifying search results such as adding/removing products or features from categories, expiring search results, and exporting search data. The class primarily manages database transactions, performs entity operations, and sets request attributes for UI rendering.

classes.name: ProductSearchEvents
classes.description: Contains static methods to handle product search related HTTP events such as adding/removing categories, features, expiring results, and exporting data within the OFBiz framework.

methods.name: searchRemoveFromCategory
methods.description: Removes products from a specified category based on search results, managing a transaction, and updating the request with success or error messages.

methods.name: searchExpireFromCategory
methods.description: Sets the 'thruDate' of search result products in a category to expire them, based on a provided date, handling transactions and errors.

methods.name: searchAddToCategory
methods.description: Adds search result products to a specified category with a given 'fromDate', managing database operations within a transaction.

methods.name: searchAddFeature
methods.description: Adds a feature to each product in the search results, setting feature application details, with error handling and transaction management.

methods.name: searchRemoveFeature
methods.description: Removes a specific feature from products in the search results, updating the database accordingly.

methods.name: searchExportProductList
methods.description: Exports the current search results as a tab-delimited list, gathering product details and related features and categories.

methods.name: getProductSearchResults
methods.description: Helper method that retrieves the current product search results iterator based on session constraints and sorting.
